author: Chris Schommer
title: Framber Valdez reinstated from bereavement list
desc: Framber Valdez has been reinstated from the bereavement list by the Detroit Tigers the club announced.
impact: Valdez returns after tending to a death in his family, with the left-hander scheduled to take the mound against the Chicago Cubs early next week for manager AJ Hinch. In a corresponding move, right-hander Beau Brieske was optioned to Triple-A Toledo.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Christian Walker dealing with hip injury
desc: The Astros say Christian Walker has right hip tightness.
impact: Walker left Saturday's game early with the injury. He is day-to-day going into Sunday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jeremy Pena dealing with hamstring cramp
desc: The Astros say Jeremy Pena has a hamstring cramp.
impact: Pena left Saturday's game early with the injury. He is day-to-day going into Sunday.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Aaron Civale being traded to Cubs
desc: Aaron Civale is being traded from the Athletics to the Chicago Cubs.
impact: Civale was designated for assignment by the Athletics earlier in the week, and they have found a trade suitor in the Cubs. The return is currently unknown, but the right-hander will have a chance to improve in the second half in Chicago. He has a 5.42 ERA and 58 strikeouts in 74 2/3 innings pitched this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Emerson Hancock (finger) to start Wednesday
desc: Emerson Hancock will start Wednesday's series finale against the Reds.
impact: Hancock left his last start before the All-Star break early. He posted a strong 3.17 ERA during the first half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luis Castillo to start Tuesday
desc: Luis Castillo will start on Tuesday against the Reds.
impact: Castillo will be making his first start post All-Star break against his former team. His name remains one to monitor heading into the trade deadline.

author: Ari Koslow
title: George Kirby to start Monday
desc: George Kirby will start on Monday against the Reds.
impact: Kirby will be making his first start post All-Star break. He posted a strong 3.76 ERA during the first half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Aaron Judge (rib) not cleared for baseball activities
desc: Yankees manager Aaron Boone said a second doctor confirmed that Aaron Judge isn't ready for baseball activities.
impact: Judge was transferred to the 60-day injured list on Saturday. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Dodgers/Yankees postponed Saturday
desc: Saturday's contest between the Los Angeles Dodgers and New York Yankees has been postponed due to sustained inclement weather the club announced.
impact: Saturday's originally scheduled contest will be made up as part of a split doubleheader beginning at 12:35pm Sunday July 19.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kyle Bradish agrees to five-year extension with Orioles
desc: Kyle Bradish has agreed to a five-year, $90 million contract extension with the Baltimore Orioles according to Jeff Passan.
impact: Bradish has offered the Orioles one of the more stable starting options despite pitching behind an inconsistent Baltimore lineup to this point, posting a 3.61 ERA and 1.35 WHIP with a 6-9 record and 8.9 K/9 ratio across 19 starts. The right-hander takes the hill for his first start since the All-Star break in Sunday's series finale against the Houston Astros.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Matt Vierling chips in two hits, steal in win over Angels
desc: Matt Vierling went 2-for-4 in a win over the Angels with one stolen base.
impact: Vierling continues a steady stretch of late, getting on base in six of his last 10 contests. The veteran remains one of the more underwhelming bats in a streaky Tigers lineup to this point, batting .211 with five home runs, 30 RBI, 23 runs scored, and four stolen bases across 82 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Troy Melton whiffs nine in no-decision Friday against Angels
desc: Troy Melton allowed one earned run on four hits and four walks while striking out nine over 5 2/3 innings in Friday's win over the Angels.
impact: Melton continues a strong stretch on the mound of late, allowing one earned run or less in each of his last five contests. The right-hander offers manager AJ Hinch another dynamic arm as part of a strong Tigers rotation, carrying a 1.80 ERA and 0.87 WHIP with a 5-1 record and 8.2 K/9 ratio across nine starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Spencer Miles torched early as Blue Jays fall to White Sox
desc: Spencer Miles allowed six earned runs on six hits while striking out four over four innings in Friday's loss to the White Sox.
impact: Miles continues a strong stretch on the mound of late, allowing two earned runs or less in seven of his last eight trips to the mound. The right-hander has offered manager John Schneider a mostly reliable arm whether starting or coming out of the bullpen, posting a 3.52 ERA and 1.13 WHIP with a 4-2 record, two holds, and 8.6 K/9 ratio through 27 appearances.
